OUR SCOPE ON THE MISSING LINK

Package 1 — The Twin Tunnels

Twin tunnels of ~1.75 km and ~8.92 km ⟨VERIFY⟩, up to 23.75 m wide — billed among the widest road tunnels in India ⟨VERIFY⟩ — driven by NATM drill-and-blast through Deccan-Trap basalt, connected by cross passages roughly every 300 m ⟨VERIFY⟩, and passing beneath the Lonavala lake region ⟨VERIFY⟩. Each tube carries four lanes of the 8-lane corridor. ⟨VERIFY⟩

Package 2, built by Afcons Infrastructure: two deep-valley viaducts including a cable-stayed span with a pylon reaching ~182 m ⟨VERIFY⟩, erected by balanced cantilever.
